name: little miss gynoid
source:
girlfailure gale is sick of people pretending. to cope, she spends most of her life literally asleep in this dystopian hellhole. one particularly rough night, a robot companion has been delivered to her flat. is it possible for what they have to be real? is she just pretending, too?
